contract_clauses.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL represent this acceptance scope as executable Given/When/Then scenarios backed by real test-runner evidence.
WHEN the BDD suite executes this acceptance group THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL run every scenario through a public surface and assert exact observable outcomes.
IF a scenario lacks a Given When Then or exact assertion THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT count that scenario as release evidence because weak or prose-only tests are not acceptance proof.
No private helper is the primary behavior surface.
Every error scenario asserts exact diagnostic or typed error.
No mutable state is shared between scenarios.
Relaxed: gate_count=0 durable=false no gate validation
Journaled: gate_count=15 durable=false bounded Fjall writer queue group commit
Strict: gate_count=15 durable=true synchronous SyncAll before acknowledgement
Workflow source compiled IR action ABI and policy digest mismatch returns typed error and must not silently continue
Non-idempotent actions blocked during recovery replay
